Excel's IMPORTCSV function lets you pull CSV data directly into your spreadsheet with one formula. No Power Query, no VBA, no opening files. In this tutorial, I'll show you how to build a dynamic dashboard that checks which regions submitted their data, totals revenue, and flags missing values — all without opening a single CSV file.
